sections.skill: Identify the rule in a stated family that fits a sequence, and continue it

sections.relationship: Students guess the next term from the look of the numbers. Writing the differences (and, if needed, the ratios) tests each rule in the family exactly.

lesson.title: Write the differences
text: Under the sequence, write the difference between each pair of neighbors.
Equal differences: rule (1). Differences that grow by the same amount: rule (3).
If neither, divide each term by the one before; equal results: rule (2).

example.title: Worked example (a different sequence)
steps: Differences: 1, 3, 5. They grow by 2 each time: rule (3).
Next difference 7, so the next term is 13 + 7 = 20.

choices.text: Only rule (3) fits, so the next term is 7.
Rule (1) fits, so the next term is 6.
Rule (2) and rule (3) both fit, giving 8 or 7 next.
Only rule (2) fits, so the next term is 8.
